text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service `canary-health-check` (INC-2026). condition: canary 5xx rate > 10% over 2m. link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-2026

pagerduty: Triggered: INC-2026 — canary-health-check — High 5xx rate (auto-page).

Sofia (eng-oncall): Oncall here, paging in. grabbing context.

Max (eng-sre): I'm coming in as second. `kubectl get pods -l app=inference-canary -n prod` shows restarts.

Sofia (eng-oncall): any customer reports? Priya, CS?

Nia (customer-success): saw 2 customers open tickets about timeouts in the last 5m, both on canary region us-west-2.

Elliot (frontend): Canary is ~10% of traffic. Frontend retries are up, we surface 502s.

Max (eng-sre): grabbing logs from canary pod.

Max (eng-sre): ```
$ kubectl logs -l release=canary -n inference --since=5m
2026-03-14T10:02:41Z ERROR model_server: KV cache miss -> OOMAlloc
2026-03-14T10:02:42Z ERROR model_server: Runtime exception: failed to alloc 512MB
```

Sofia (eng-oncall): OOMs in canary runtime — possibly new quantization code path in v2.11. Who rolled that?

Priya (prodops): Rollout 2.11 started ~9:55, gradual canary across 10 hosts. New kernel selection enabled.

James (pm): Confirming: this is the new release with updated kernel/kvcache heuristics.

Max (eng-sre): On all canary instances seeing repeated `failed to alloc` stack. Memory pressure spike after first 50 requests.

Sofia (eng-oncall): Impact estimate?

Priya (prodops): Canary is 12% traffic in us-west-2. Error rate ~18% for canary bucket, overall platform error rate +0.9%. No SLA breaches yet but trending.

Nia (customer-success): Customer A reported 30s timeouts then 502s, asked if we reverted. They are impacted on their API flows.

Sofia (eng-oncall): Decision: hold rollout and rollback canary to v2.10. Priya, can you execute rollback? Max start mitigation for surviving pods.

Priya (prodops): Starting rollback now — running `deployctl rollback inference-canary --to v2.10 --wait`

pagerduty: ACK by Sofia (eng-oncall) at 2634007905.

Max (eng-sre): Also reducing canary traffic to 0% via traffic-split to divert to stable while rollback completes.

Priya (prodops): Traffic split updated: canary -> 0%, stable -> 100%. rollback job in progress (job id rlb-8321).

incident-bot: Rollback job rlb-8321 completed successfully. All canary nodes now running v2.10.

Sofia (eng-oncall): Monitoring - please watch 5xx rate for next 10m.

Elliot (frontend): Frontend metrics show 5xx drop back to baseline within ~30s.

Nia (customer-success): Notified affected customers that we rolled back and asked them to confirm.

James (pm): Good call. Assigning postmortem to Max + Priya. Include rollout checklist gap and memory profiling for new kernel selection.

Max (eng-sre): Action items: 1) collect heap dumps from failing nodes (done), 2) run memory profiler on v2.11 branch, 3) add canary memory smoke test to CI.

Priya (prodops): Follow-up: increase canary node memory by +2G for testing branch and re-run integration tests.

Sofia (eng-oncall): Closing incident channel once we have confirmation from CS and metrics stable. Last check-in in 10m.

pagerduty: Resolved INC-2026 by rollback action at 2634008118.

incident-bot: Postmortem ticket created: INT-6543. Owner: Max (eng-sre). Due: 2026-03-21.

Sofia (eng-oncall): Thanks team — nice quick rollback. Will hand off to oncall follow-up. :thumbsup:
